title: hydrangea hortensia f. otaksa
intro: Hydrangea hortensia f. otaksa, commonly known as Bigleaf Hydrangea, is a deciduous shrub native to Asia, known for its large, showy flowers and medicinal properties. The plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin problems, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Hydrangea hortensia f. otaksa include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its wound-healing and anti-aging effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal activities.
